rationale: The described offering is a server-side development environment for building and deploying web applications, with a component model based on JavaBeans and JSPs; personalization is an application capability, not an AI method stated for the platform.
evidence_spans: provides an open, server-side environment for building and deploying dynamic, personalized applications for the web and other communication channels, such as email and wireless devices.
applications implement a component development model based on JavaBeans and JSPs.
conflict_response: In context, the offering is the server-side application-development environment and component model. 'Personalized' describes the applications that can be built, but the text assigns no AI mechanism to the platform; the conventional development functions support non-AI without asserting how every deployed application personalizes content.
